description: Plan walkable neighborhood itineraries with weather checks, currency conversion, and calendar and route exports.

defaultPrompt: Plan a 3-day walkable city trip with neighborhood clusters and transit buffers. Ask me for the destination and dates.
Audit my itinerary for rain and suggest nearby indoor backups. Ask me to share the itinerary and dates.
Export my itinerary as an .ics schedule using local event times. Ask me for any missing dates, times, or destination.
interface.longDescription: Plan realistic city days with neighborhood clusters, transit buffers, rain alternatives, and calendar and route exports. Live checks depend on the tools available in the host.
